```{r launch, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
num <- function(x,round_precision =  NULL)
{
	if (is.null(round_precision)) {
		return(sprintf("\\num{%s}", x))
	} else {
		return(sprintf("\\num[round-precision=%s]{%s}",round_precision+1, x))
	}
}
```

# Calculate mortalities, per dam, per turbines.


The EDA is based on S4 classes, a system which allow inheritance of methods
  from parent classes and ensure the integrity of data. It also facilitates
  class management. The main class for GT2 is available   [code in
  trac](http://185.135.126.250/traceda/browser/eda/EDA_Rios/BaseEdaRiosRiversegmentsDamTurb.R) "Source code for the main turbine mortality class").


This class has methods. The method `loaddb` loads everything from the database
using the class methods. In particular it loads :

* a table of all dams downstream from one segment. 
* a table of all the dams in France, Spain and portugal,
* a table if all riversegments in France and their attributes,
* a table of all hydro power plant data in France, this table collates the
  silver eel production upstream and the classified flows applied at each
  idsegment with colnames
  c("id", "op_id", "op_gis_systemname", "op_gis_layername", "op_gislocation",
  "op_placename", "op_op_id", "id_original", "country", "ob_id", "ob_no_origin",
  "ob_no_type", "ob_no_period", "ob_starting_date", "dp_name",
  "ot_no_obstruction_type", "ot_obstruction_number", "ot_no_mortality_type",
  "ot_no_mortality", "po_no_obstruction_passability", "po_obstruction_height",
  "po_downs_pb", "po_downs_water_depth", "date_last_update",
  "author_last_update", "comment_update", "mitigation_measure_no_id", "hpp_id",
  "hpp_name", "hpp_main_grid_or_production", "hpp_presence_bypass",
  "hpp_total_flow_bypass", "hpp_orient_flow_no_id", "hpp_presence_of_bar_rack",
  "hpp_bar_rack_space", "hpp_surface_bar_rack", "hpp_inclination_bar_rack",
  "hpp_presence_bypass_trashrack", "hpp_nb_trashrack_bypass",
  "hpp_turb_max_flow", "hpp_reserved_flow", "hpp_flow_trashrack_bypass",
  "hpp_max_power", "hpp_orientation_bar_rack", "hpp_id_original", "hpp_source",
  "googlemapscoods", "idsegment", "cnfemale300450", "cnfemale450600",
  "cnfemale600750", "cnfemale750", "cnmale150300", "cnmale300450",
  "cnmale450600", "cnsilver150300", "cnsilver300450", "cnsilver450600",
  "cnsilver600750", "cnsilver750", "cnsilver", "code_hydro_station",
  "q_1004_10", "q_1004_20", "q_1004_30", "q_1004_40", "q_1004_50", "q_1004_60",
  "q_1004_70", "q_1004_80", "q_1004_90", "q_1004_95", "q_1004_99" )


* a table of all turbines in France as avalailable in the database,
c("op_id", "op_gis_systemname", "op_gis_layername", "op_gislocation",
  "op_placename", "observation_place_type_name", "op_op_id", "the_geom",
  "id_original", "country", "ob_id", "ob_no_origin", "ob_no_type",
  "ob_no_period", "ob_starting_date", "ob_ending_date", "ob_op_id", "dp_name",
  "obstruction_type_code", "obstruction_type_name", "ot_obstruction_number",
  "ot_no_mortality_type", "ot_no_mortality", "obstruction_impact_code",
  "obstruction_impact_name", "po_obstruction_height", "po_downs_pb",
  "po_downs_water_depth", "po_presence_eel_pass", "po_method_perm_ev",
  "po_date_presence_eel_pass", "fishway_type_code", "fishway_type_name",
  "downstream_mitigation_measure_name", "googlemapscoods", "idsegment",
  "cnfemale300450", "cnfemale450600", "cnfemale600750", "cnfemale750",
  "cnmale150300", "cnmale300450", "cnmale450600", "cnsilver150300",
  "cnsilver300450", "cnsilver450600", "cnsilver600750", "cnsilver750",
  "cnsilver", "code_hydro_station", "q_1004_10", "q_1004_20", "q_1004_30",
  "q_1004_40", "q_1004_50", "q_1004_60", "q_1004_70", "q_1004_80", "q_1004_90",
  "q_1004_95", "q_1004_99" )

 
* a table of all silver eel productions from the upstream basin, so for
  each riversegment the number of silver eels supposed to come from
  upstream (EDA2.3).
* a table of all the classified flows applied at the idsegment level.
  
The first table, containing all segments downstream from all
  riversegments, has a lot of lines (about 6 million for France), so we try not
  to run it unless changes have occured in the database. In the
  end, it produces very simple tables with the mortality calculated at the
  turbine level or at the dam level.

The R code for turbine mortalities is below

```{r method_turbine_mortality, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
#' method to calculate turbine mortalities 
#' calculates mortality at dam level and at turbine level
#' @note This function takes as input an object of class BaseEdaRiosRiversegmentsDamTurb. This object 
#' @returnType Object of class BaseEda
#' @return BaseEdaRiosRiversegmentsDamTurb
#' @author Cedric Briand \email{cedric.briand@@lavilaine.com}, 
#' for test write 	assign("showmerequest",1,envir=.GlobalEnv)
setMethod("turbine_mortality",signature=signature("BaseEdaRiosRiversegmentsDamTurb"),
		definition=function(
				object, 
				size_table_eel= NULL,
				size_table_sat= NULL,
				middle_class_eel = c(0.5,0.7,0.9), 
				middle_class_sat = c(0.15,0.18)				
		) {
			#debug object<-turb_rios		
			#=========================================
			# Initialize data from the object
			#========================================		
			
			turbine <- object@tableturbinedbeel
			hpp <- object@tablehppdbeel
			hpp$op_id_pere<-hpp$op_id # par défaut l'ouvrage père est lui meme
			hpp$op_id_pere[!is.na(hpp$op_op_id)]	<- hpp$op_op_id[!is.na(hpp$op_op_id)]	
			hpp_turb <- inner_join(hpp, turbine, by=c("hpp_id"="turb_hpp_id")) 
			
			
			# Default values for size class proporition, this is calculated at each idsegment in the sudoang project
#			if (is.null(size_table_eel)) size_table_eel<-	data.frame(
#						"3 - [300-450["=rep(0.25,nrow(hpp_turb)),
#						"4 - [450-600["=rep(0.25,nrow(hpp_turb)),
#						"5 - [600-750["=rep(0.25,nrow(hpp_turb)),
#						">=750"=rep(0.25,nrow(hpp_turb)))
			if (is.null(size_table_eel)) size_table_eel<-	data.frame(
						"50"=rep(1/3,nrow(hpp_turb)),
						"70"=rep(1/3,nrow(hpp_turb)),
						"90"=rep(1/3,nrow(hpp_turb)))
			stopifnot(ncol(size_table_eel)==length(middle_class_eel))
			# these must be proportions : 
			stopifnot(all(round(rowSums(size_table_eel))==1|is.na(round(rowSums(size_table_eel)))))
			nbna <- sum((is.na(rowSums(size_table_eel))))
			if (nbna>0) warning(sprintf("There are %s NA values for size_table_eel",nbna))
			
			if (is.null(size_table_sat)) size_table_sat<-	data.frame(
						"15"=rep(1/2,nrow(hpp_turb)),
						"18"=rep(1/2,nrow(hpp_turb)))			
			stopifnot(ncol(size_table_sat)==length(middle_class_sat))
			# these must be proportions : 
			stopifnot(all(round(rowSums(size_table_sat))==1|is.na(round(rowSums(size_table_sat)))))
			nbna <- sum((is.na(rowSums(size_table_sat))))
			if (nbna>0) warning(sprintf("There are %s NA values for size_table_sat",nbna))
			#=========================================
			# Missing data treatment (initialisation and treatment function)
			#========================================
			
			hpp_turb$typecalca<-NA
			hpp_turb$typecalcs<-NA
			# function to update missing values code if 2_1 and 2_2 will get 2_12
			# along the script we will have vectors of index for reindexing, these will be used to set
			# missing data
			
			
			# Vectors to qualify data
			# 1= (full) all data are available for calculations
			# 2= (supplementary assumption) 
			# 2_1 equiment_flow, assumption the turbines have equal flow and turbine flow missing is replaced by hpp max turbine flow
			# 2_2 blades if the number of blades is not there add missing blades
			# 2_3 missing equipment flow
			# 2_4 Calculation of turbine diameter (From Rotation speed and Q) 
			# 2_5 Calculation of turbine diameter (From Q)        
			# 2_6 Dam_height (not present in HPP table => collected at dam level)
			# 2_7 Diameter francis
			# 3= Formula used
			# 3_1 Bosc_Larinier_2000
			# 3_2 Larinier_Dartiguelongue_1989 or "Larinier_Travade_2002"
			# 3_3 Default for Pelton or VLH
			# 3_4 =  QND  Eel mortalities Gomes and larinier 2008
			# 3_5 =  QN  Eel mortalities Gomes and larinier 2008
			# 3_7 =  ND  Eel mortalities Gomes and larinier 2008
			# 3_8 =  Taux de mortalité pour les Pelton ou Ichtyocompatibles
			# 4= (Mean.) Average all types : we don't know the type of turbines
			# Average values kaplan 4_1
			# Average values francis 4_2
			# Average values All 4_3
			# 5 Fine grid
			# values will be separated by & (between large categories and _ to separate categories and subcateries and + within subcategories 
#			update_code(c("2_1",NA,"3"),"4_2") #"2_1&4_2" "4_2"     "3&4_2"
#			update_code(c("2_1",NA,"3"),"2_2") #"2_1+2" "2_2"   "3&2_2"
			
			update_code <- function(vector,value){
				if (all(is.na(vector))) {
					vector<-value 
					return(vector)
				}
				# vector <-c("2_1",NA,"1"); value <-"2_2"
				if (nchar(value)>1 & !grepl("_",value)) stop ("value length > 1 should contain an underscore")
				vectorcodelevel1 <- sapply(strsplit(vector,"_"),function(x)x[1])
				vectorcodelevel1[is.na(vectorcodelevel1)] <- "NA" # will not be used but avoid NA
				valuecodelevel1 <- strsplit(value,"_")[[1]][1]
				valuecodelevel2 <- strsplit(value,"_")[[1]][2]
				vector[!is.na(vector) & vectorcodelevel1%in%valuecodelevel1] <- 
						paste0(vector[!is.na(vector) & vectorcodelevel1%in%valuecodelevel1],"+",valuecodelevel2)		
				vector[!is.na(vector) & !vectorcodelevel1%in%valuecodelevel1] <- 
						paste0(vector[!is.na(vector) & !vectorcodelevel1%in%valuecodelevel1],"&",value)							
				# if nothing yet in vector just put the value
				vector[is.na(vector)]<-value
				return(vector)
			}
			
			
			#==========================================
			# Number of turbine per HPP
			#==========================================
			
			tab_nb_turbines<-as.data.frame(table(hpp_turb$op_id_pere))
			colnames(tab_nb_turbines)<-c("op_id_pere","nb_turbine_entree")
			if ("nb_turbine_entree" %in% colnames(hpp_turb)){
				hpp_turb<-hpp_turb[,-match("nb_turbine_entree",colnames(hpp_turb))]
			}
			hpp_turb<-merge(hpp_turb,tab_nb_turbines,by="op_id_pere",all.x=TRUE,all.y=FALSE)
			rm(tab_nb_turbines)
			
			#==========================================
			# Change types to only five types from types in dbeel
			#==========================================
			
			level_key <- c("242"="Kaplan",
					"243"="Other",
					"244"="Francis",
					"245"="Francis",
					"246"="Kaplan",
					"247"="Kaplan", #Kaplan not specified
					"248"="Pelton",
					"249"="Kaplan", # Reversible
					"250"="Kaplan", #Turbine type;Kaplan (model of S-turbine)
					"251"="Kaplan", #Turbine with fixed blade propeller and horizontal axis
					"252"="Other",   #Turbine type;Unknown
					"253"="Kaplan", #Turbine type;Vertical axis Kaplan
					"254"="Francis", #Turbine type;Francis without volute
					"255"="Francis", #Turbine type;Francis (spiral case)
					"256"="Pelton", #Turbine type;Banki-Michell (cross-flow)
					"257"="Ichtyocompatible",    #Turbine type;VLH
					"258"="Ichtyocompatible",   #Turbine type;Archimedean screw turbine
					"259"="Wheel",    #Turbine type;Water wheel turbine (aqualienne)
					"260"="Wheel",   #Turbine type;Water wheel turbine (others)
					"261"="Other")   #Turbine type;Propeller unspecified		
			hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul <- NA # initialize variable
			hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul <- recode(hpp_turb$turb_turbine_type_no_id, !!!level_key)
			
			
# if the turbines is "other" and there is a mitigation measure at dam level saying Fish friendly turbine
# and we are in France
# then the type of turbine passes to VLH 
			hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul[is.na(hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul)] <- "Other"
			test <- hpp_turb$op_gis_layername=="roe" &
					hpp_turb$mitigation_measure_no_id==283 &
					!is.na(hpp_turb$mitigation_measure_no_id) &
					hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Other"
			if (sum(test)>0){
				cat( paste("The following dams with code \n",
								hpp_turb$id_original[test], collapse=","),"\n", 
						paste(hpp_turb$hpp_name[test], collapse=",\n"),
						"\n =>  are dams considered with VLH\n")
				hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul[test] <- "Ichtyocompatible"					
			}
			#==========================================
			# flow (2_1)
			#==========================================
# The flow in the turbine, correspond the the maximum flow in the turbine
# but may correspond to equipment flow divided by the number of turbines, when information is missing
			
			naturbQ <- is.na(hpp_turb$turb_max_turbine_flow) # turbine Q with NA
			nahppQ <- is.na(hpp_turb$hpp_turb_max_flow)  # hpp Q with NA
			hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement[!naturbQ] <- hpp_turb$turb_max_turbine_flow[!naturbQ] 
			test_not  <-  naturbQ&!nahppQ # when turbine flow is not there but we have max turbine flow at the dam
			hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement[test_not] <- hpp_turb$hpp_turb_max_flow[test_not]/hpp_turb$nb_turbine_entree[test_not] 
			hpp_turb$typecalca[test_not] <- update_code(hpp_turb$typecalca[test_not],"2_1")
			hpp_turb$typecalcs[test_not] <- update_code(hpp_turb$typecalcs[test_not],"2_1")
			
			
			#==========================================
			# Number of blades (2_2)
			#==========================================
# Turbines Kaplan for blade if missing values then 4 blades
			
			test_missing_blades_kaplan <- hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Kaplan" & is.na(hpp_turb$turb_nb_blades)
			hpp_turb[test_missing_blades_kaplan,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[test_missing_blades_kaplan,"typecalca"],"2_2")
			hpp_turb[test_missing_blades_kaplan,"typecalcs"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[test_missing_blades_kaplan,"typecalcs"],"2_2")
			hpp_turb[which(hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Kaplan"&is.na(hpp_turb$turb_nb_blades)),"turb_nb_blades"]<-4
			
			#==========================================
			# Missing equiment flow (2_3)
			#==========================================
# TODO check if we do this 
#Pour les barrages en auto-consommation on met en débit d'équipement la moyenne des débits d'équipement où on a les données
# this information is not available in our database
#			hpp_turb[hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production==1&is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)&!is.na(hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production),"typecalca"]<-2
#			hpp_turb[hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production==1&is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)&!is.na(hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production),"typecalcs"]<-2
#			hpp_turb[hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production==1&is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)&!is.na(hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production),"q_max_q_equipement"]<-mean(hpp_turb[hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production==1,"hpp_turb_max_flow"],na.rm=TRUE)/hpp_turb[hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production==1&is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)&!is.na(hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production),"nb_turbine_entree"]
			
#Pour les barrages en production on met un Qe=75% du module
			
#      test_missing_q_max_q_equipement <- is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)
#			hpp_turb[hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production==2&is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)
#							&!is.na(hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production),"typecalca"]<-2
#			hpp_turb[hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production==2&is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)
#							&!is.na(hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production),"typecalcs"]<-2
#			hpp_turb[hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production==2&is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)
#							&!is.na(hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production),"q_max_q_equipement"] <-(0.75*hpp_turb[hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production==2&is.na
#										(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)&!is.na(hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production)
#								,"module"])  /hpp_turb[hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production==2&is.na
#									(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)&!is.na(hpp_turb$autoconso_ou_production),"nb_turbine_entree"]
			
			#==================================================================================================
			# Turbine diameter recalculation (2_4) (2_5)
			#
			# The diameter of turbines wheel has been calculated with two formulas (Gomes et Larinier, 2008)
			# without flow we are sure to get NA for mortality
			# diameter_mc = diameter measured or calculated
			#************************************************************************************************
			hpp_turb$diameter_mc <- hpp_turb$turb_diameter  
			test1 <- is.na(hpp_turb$turb_diameter)& 
					hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Kaplan"&
					!is.na(hpp_turb$turb_rotation_speed) &
					!is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)
			test2 <- is.na(hpp_turb$turb_diameter)&
					hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Kaplan"&
					is.na(hpp_turb$turb_rotation_speed) &
					!is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)
			hpp_turb$diameter_mc[test1]<-(3.82*hpp_turb$turb_rotation_speed^(-0.307)*hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement^0.328)[test1]
			hpp_turb$diameter_mc[test2]<-(0.618*hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement^0.408)[test2]
			hpp_turb[test1,"typecalcs"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[test1,"typecalcs"],"2_4")
			hpp_turb[test1,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[test1,"typecalca"],"2_4")
			hpp_turb[test2,"typecalcs"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[test2,"typecalcs"],"2_5")
			hpp_turb[test2,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[test2,"typecalca"],"2_5")
			# hpp_turb$typecalca
			#==========================================
			# Dam_height (2_6)
			#==========================================
			#***********************************************************************************************
			# If the height is not given in turbine table, we collect from dam level
			#************************************************************************************************			
			
			test_missing_height <- is.na(hpp_turb$turb_hpp_height) & !is.na(hpp_turb$po_obstruction_height)
			hpp_turb$turb_hpp_height[test_missing_height] <- hpp_turb$po_obstruction_height[test_missing_height]
			hpp_turb[test_missing_height,"typecalcs"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[test_missing_height,"typecalcs"],"2_6")
			hpp_turb[test_missing_height,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[test_missing_height,"typecalca"],"2_6")
			
			#==========================================
			# Rotation speed Francis (2_7)
			#==========================================
			
			# Source devalpomi, recalculating rotation speed from dam's height
			testrotation<-is.na(hpp_turb$turb_rotation_speed)&hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Francis"&!is.na(hpp_turb$turb_hpp_height)
			hpp_turb$turb_rotation_speed[testrotation] <- 71.725+log(hpp_turb$turb_hpp_height[testrotation])*43.776
			hpp_turb[testrotation,"typecalcs"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[testrotation,"typecalcs"],"2_7")
			hpp_turb[testrotation,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[testrotation,"typecalca"],"2_7")			
			
			
			#==========================================
			# diameter Francis (2_8)
			#==========================================			
			
			testdiam <- is.na(hpp_turb$diameter_mc)&hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Francis"&!is.na(hpp_turb$turb_hpp_height)
			hpp_turb$diameter_mc[testdiam]<-pmin(0.26*hpp_turb$turb_hpp_height[testdiam],2.5)
			hpp_turb[testdiam,"typecalcs"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[testdiam,"typecalcs"],"2_8")
			hpp_turb[testdiam,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[testdiam,"typecalca"],"2_8")
			
			
			
			#========================================			
			#========================================
			# SALMON MORTALITIES
			#========================================
			#========================================			
			
			
			
			
			
			#==========================================
			# Formula for salmon
			# 3_1 Bosc_Larinier_2000
			# 3_2 Larinier_Dartiguelongue_1989 or "Larinier_Travade_2002"
			# 3_3 Default for Pelton or VLH
			#==========================================					
			
			
			hpp_turb$mortality_smolt <- smolt_mortality_allsize(
					size_table = size_table_sat, 
					middle_class = middle_class_sat,
					Dr = hpp_turb$diameter_mc,
					nbblade = hpp_turb$turb_nb_blades,  
					typ = hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul,
					H = hpp_turb$turb_hpp_height,
					N = hpp_turb$turb_rotation_speed,
					Q = hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement,
					formulek = "Bosc_Larinier_2000",
					formulef = "Bosc_Larinier_2000",
					return_type="vector")
			
			hpp_turb$typecalcs[is.na(hpp_turb$typecalcs) & !is.na(hpp_turb$mortality_smolt)] <- 1
			# Kaplan
			indexk <- hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Kaplan" & !is.na(hpp_turb$diameter_mc) & !is.na(hpp_turb$turb_nb_blades)
			hpp_turb[indexk,"typecalcs"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[indexk,"typecalcs"],"3_1")
			
			# Francis
			indexf <- hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Francis" & !is.na(hpp_turb$turb_hpp_height) & !is.na(hpp_turb$diameter_mc) & !is.na(hpp_turb$turb_rotation_speed)
			hpp_turb[indexf,"typecalcs"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[indexf,"typecalcs"],"3_2")
			
			# Other
			indexo <- hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul%in%c("Pelton","Ichtyocompatible") & !is.na(hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul)
			hpp_turb[indexo,"typecalcs"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[indexo,"typecalcs"],"3_3")
			
			#==========================================			
			#==========================================
			# EEL MORTALITIES CALCULATIONS
			#==========================================		
			#==========================================			
			#==========================================
			# Eel mortalities Gomes and larinier 2008 QND=3_4 QN=3_5  ND=3_6 francis=3_7 other turbines=3_8
			#==========================================			
			
			hpp_turb$q_vit_dia<-NA
			idxQND <- !is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)&!is.na(hpp_turb$turb_rotation_speed)&!is.na(hpp_turb$diameter_mc)
			hpp_turb$q_vit_dia[idxQND]<-"QND"
			
			idxQN <- !is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)&!is.na(hpp_turb$turb_rotation_speed)&is.na(hpp_turb$diameter_mc)
			hpp_turb$q_vit_dia[idxQN]<-"QN"
			
			idxND <- is.na(hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement)&!is.na(hpp_turb$turb_rotation_speed)&!is.na(hpp_turb$diameter_mc)
			hpp_turb$q_vit_dia[idxND]<-"ND"
			
			
			hpp_turb$mortality_eel <- eel_mortality_allsize(
					size_table = size_table_eel, 
					middle_class = middle_class_eel,		 
					Dr =  hpp_turb$diameter_mc,
					H = hpp_turb$turb_hpp_height,
					N = hpp_turb$turb_rotation_speed,
					Q = hpp_turb$q_max_q_equipement,
					QND=hpp_turb$q_vit_dia,
					typ = hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul,
					return_type="vector")
			
			hpp_turb$typecalca[is.na(hpp_turb$typecalca) & !is.na(hpp_turb$mortality_eel)] <- 1
			indexk <- hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Kaplan" & !is.na(hpp_turb$diameter_mc) & !is.na(hpp_turb$turb_nb_blades)
			hpp_turb[idxQND&indexk,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[idxQND&indexk,"typecalca"],"3_4")
			hpp_turb[idxQN&indexk,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[idxQN&indexk,"typecalca"],"3_5")
			hpp_turb[idxND&indexk,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[idxND&indexk,"typecalca"],"3_6")
			indexf <- hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Francis" & !is.na(hpp_turb$turb_hpp_height) & !is.na(hpp_turb$diameter_mc) & !is.na(hpp_turb$turb_rotation_speed)
			indexo <- hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul%in%c("Pelton","Ichtyocompatible") & !is.na(hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul)
			hpp_turb[indexf,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[indexf,"typecalca"],"3_7")
			hpp_turb[indexo,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[indexo,"typecalca"],"3_8")
			
			#==========================================			
			#==========================================
			# Replacing missing with average values
			#==========================================		
			#==========================================			
			mean_per_type <- hpp_turb %>% 
					select(typ_turbine_calcul,mortality_smolt,mortality_eel) %>% 
					group_by(typ_turbine_calcul) %>%
					summarize(
							mean_smolt=mean(mortality_smolt, na.rm=TRUE),
							mean_eel=mean(mortality_eel, na.rm=TRUE),
							sd_smolt=sd(mortality_smolt, na.rm=TRUE),
							sd_eel=sd(mortality_eel, na.rm=TRUE)							
					)
			mean_global <- hpp_turb %>% select(typ_turbine_calcul,mortality_smolt,mortality_eel) %>% 
					filter(typ_turbine_calcul!="Ichtyocompatible") %>%
					summarize(
							mean_smolt=mean(mortality_smolt, na.rm=TRUE),
							mean_eel=mean(mortality_eel, na.rm=TRUE),
							sd_smolt=sd(mortality_smolt, na.rm=TRUE),
							sd_eel=sd(mortality_eel, na.rm=TRUE)							
					)
			
			#==========================================
			# Average values kaplan 4_1
			#==========================================	
			# smolt
			index_recalc_sk2 <- is.na(hpp_turb$mortality_smolt) & hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Kaplan" & !is.na(hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul)
			hpp_turb$mortality_smolt[index_recalc_sk2] <-
					as.numeric(mean_per_type[mean_per_type$typ_turbine_calcul=="Kaplan","mean_smolt"])
			hpp_turb[index_recalc_sk2,"typecalcs"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[index_recalc_sk2,"typecalcs"],"4_1")
			
			# eel
			index_recalc_ak2 <- is.na(hpp_turb$mortality_eel) & hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Kaplan" & !is.na(hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul)
			hpp_turb$mortality_eel[index_recalc_ak2] <-
					as.numeric(mean_per_type[mean_per_type$typ_turbine_calcul=="Kaplan","mean_eel"])
			hpp_turb[index_recalc_ak2,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[index_recalc_ak2,"typecalca"],"4_1")
			
			#==========================================
			# Average values francis 4_2
			#==========================================	
			
			# smolt
			index_recalc_sf2 <- is.na(hpp_turb$mortality_smolt) & hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Francis" & !is.na(hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul)
			hpp_turb$mortality_smolt[index_recalc_sf2] <-
					as.numeric(mean_global[mean_per_type$typ_turbine_calcul=="Francis","mean_smolt"])
			hpp_turb[index_recalc_sf2,"typecalcs"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[index_recalc_sf2,"typecalcs"],"4_2")
			
			# eel
			index_recalc_af2<-is.na(hpp_turb$mortality_eel) & hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Francis" & !is.na(hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul)
			hpp_turb$mortality_eel[index_recalc_af2] <-
					as.numeric(mean_per_type[mean_per_type$typ_turbine_calcul=="Francis","mean_eel"])
			hpp_turb[index_recalc_af2,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[index_recalc_af2,"typecalca"],"4_2")
			
			#==========================================
			# Average values All 4_3
			#==========================================	
			
			# smolt
			index_recalc_sa2 <-is.na(hpp_turb$mortality_smolt) & (is.na(hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul) | hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Other")
			hpp_turb$mortality_smolt[index_recalc_sa2] <-
					as.numeric(mean_global$mean_smolt)
			hpp_turb[index_recalc_sa2,"typecalcs"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[index_recalc_sa2,"typecalcs"],"4_3")
			
			# eel
			index_recalc_aa2<-is.na(hpp_turb$mortality_eel) &  (is.na(hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul) | hpp_turb$typ_turbine_calcul=="Other")
			hpp_turb$mortality_eel[index_recalc_aa2] <-
					as.numeric(mean_global$mean_eel)
			hpp_turb[index_recalc_aa2,"typecalca"] <- update_code(hpp_turb[index_recalc_aa2,"typecalca"],"4_3")
			
			
			#==========================================
			# Grids 5
			#==========================================	
			
			
			
			indx_grillefine<-!is.na(hpp_turb$hpp_bar_rack_space)&hpp_turb$hpp_bar_rack_space<=20
			hpp_turb$typecalca[indx_grillefine]<-5
			hpp_turb$typecalcs[indx_grillefine]<-5
			hpp_turb[indx_grillefine,"mortality_eel"]<-0
			hpp_turb[indx_grillefine,"mortality_smolt"]<-0
			
			
#			hpp_turb$typecalca[indx_enservice]<-6
#			hpp_turb$typecalcs[indx_enservice]<-6
#			hpp_turb[indx_enservice,"mortalite_ang"]<-0
#			hpp_turb[indx_enservice,"mortalite_sat"]<-0
			
			object@tablemortalityturbine <- hpp_turb
			
			#==========================================
			# Treatment per dam
			#==========================================	
			# mortality corresponds to the weighted sum of  mortality according to the flow
			tablemortalitydam <-					hpp_turb %>% 
					mutate(
							op_id_pere ={
								list=is.na(op_id_pere)
								replace(op_id_pere,list,op_id)
							}) %>%
					select(op_id_pere, mortality_eel, mortality_smolt, q_max_q_equipement) %>%
					group_by(op_id_pere) %>%
					mutate(
							q_max_q_equipement ={
								mask=is.na(q_max_q_equipement)
								replace(q_max_q_equipement,mask,1)
							})  %>%
					summarize(
							mortality_eel = sum(mortality_eel*q_max_q_equipement)/sum(q_max_q_equipement), 
							qtottal=sum(q_max_q_equipement))
			
			# finish and give one value per dam
			
			object@tablemortalitydam <- tablemortalitydam
			return(object)
		}
)

```

# Size structure of migrants

The mortality in turbines is highly dependent on size. We have split the eel
size into classes : 150-300mm (and yes they are rare but there are silver
eels with size lower than 300), 300-450, ..., 600-750, and larger than 750 mm

OK ... but what is the size you apply to the class 300-450, 375 ?, the largest
size ? 

To answer this question we use the silver eel dataset compiled in the main
report. Here we load it and calculate the size structure of silver eel per size
class. For instance in the class 150-300 the mean size is not 175. In most cases
the mean size will be lower than the mean of the class because there are more
small eels than large eels. In some cases (150-300)mm, as getting silver below a
size of 300mm is quite rare we get closer to 300, for > 750 it depends also on
the right hand side of the distribution.

```{r size_structure, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE}
load(file=file.path(ddatawd, "silver_eel.Rdata"))
silver_eel$country <- as.factor(silver_eel$country)


# This is the size structure for males and females

silver_eel %>% filter(sexe_durif!="immature") %>%
		select("length", "sexe_durif", "size") %>%
		group_by( sexe_durif, size) %>% 
		summarize(N=n(),
				Mean=round(mean(length)),
				Min=min(length),
				Q3=quantile(length,0.25),
				Median=quantile(length,0.5),
				Q5=quantile(length,0.75),
				Max=max(length)) %>%
		kable(escape = F, align = "c") %>%
		kable_styling(c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = T)

# This is the size structure for all

silver_eel %>% filter(sexe_durif!="immature") %>%
		select("length",  "size") %>%
		group_by( size) %>% 
		summarize(N=n(),
				Mean=round(mean(length)),
				Min=min(length),
				Q3=quantile(length,0.25),
				Median=quantile(length,0.5),
				Q5=quantile(length,0.75),
				Max=max(length)) %>%
		kable(escape = F, align = "c") %>%
		kable_styling(c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = T)

```
The turbine mortalities are calculated from the functions `eel_mortality_size`
which compute the mortality for a single size, and `eel_mortality_allsize`
which compute the mortalities for a size structure


```{r test_of_individual_functions, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE}

#' Calculation of turbines mortality for eel for Kaplan and Francis turbines.
#' For Kaplan Gomes et Larinier, 2008 propose three formulas given mortality percentage (M) according to eel size
#'  size (TL in m), wheel diameter Dr (in m), nominal flow Q (in m3/s) and turbine rotation speed N (in trn/min) :
#'  M1 : M (%) = 4.67 TL^1.53 Dr^-0.48 N^0.6
#'  M2 : M (%) = 6.59 TL^1.63 Q^-0.24 N^0.63
#'  M3 : M (%) = 12.42 TL^1.36 Q^-0.22 Dr^-0.10 N^0.49
#' For Francis, we use the formula developped for salmon by Bosc and Larinier (2000)
#'  M4 : M(%) =  100*sin((pi/180)*pmin(90,-17.98 + 45.62 *  H^0.181 * Q^-0.207 * TL^0.224))^2
#' @param Size The fish size in meter : must be unique (not a vector) see smolt_mortality_all_size to use several size
#' @param Dr Diameter of the wheel, in m
#' @param Q Flow in the turbine in m3 per second
#' @param N Rotation speed in turn per minute
#' @param H height of dam in m
#' @param QND A vector describing whether Q N and D are avalaible. Given data availabilities, different formulas are used
#' see Gomez and Larinier, 2008
#' @param typ PARAM_DESCRIPTION, Default: c("Kaplan", "Francis", "Pelton", "Ichtyocompatible")
#' @return A vector of mortalities
#' @examples 
#' \dontrun{
#' if(interactive()){
#eel_mortality_size(Dr=1.78,Q=8,N=117,H=3,QND="QND",size=0.70, typ="Francis") #21.49
#eel_mortality_size(Dr=1.3,Q=5.2,N=205,H=3,QND="QND",size=0.70, typ="Kaplan") #70.35
#'  }
#' }
#' @rdname eel_mortality_size
#' @export 
eel_mortality_size<-function(
		Dr,
		Q,
		N,
		H,
		QND,
		size,
		typ=c("Kaplan","Francis","Pelton","Ichtyocompatible"))
{
	# --- initial tests -----------------------------------------
	
	typ[is.na(typ)]<-"NA"
	if (! all(typ%in%c("Kaplan","Francis","Pelton","Ichtyocompatible"))) 
		warning(sprintf("typ %s not processed, should be one of 'Kaplan', 'Francis', 'Pelton', 'Ichtyocompatible'", 
						unique( typ[!typ%in%c("Kaplan","Francis","Pelton","Ichtyocompatible")])))
	QND[is.na(QND)]<-"NA"
	if (! all(QND%in%c("QND","QN","ND","NA"))) {
		warning(sprintf("QND %s not processed, should be one of 'QND','QN','ND'", 
						unique(QND[!QND%in%c("QND","QN","ND")])))
	}
	if (size>1) warning("Size >1 : size should be provided in meter")
	# --- Check types -----------------------------------------	
	M <- rep(NA,length(typ))
	indexk <- typ=="Kaplan" & !is.na(typ)
	indexf <- typ=="Francis" & !is.na(typ)
	indexp <- typ=="Pelton" & !is.na(typ)
	indexi <- typ=="Ichtyocompatible" & !is.na(typ)
	
	# --- Kaplan ------------------------------------------------
	idxQND  <-  QND=="QND"
	idxQN  <-  QND=="QN"
	idxND  <-  QND=="ND"
	if (sum(indexk&idxQND)>0) 
		M[indexk&idxQND] <- pmin(100,12.42*size^1.36*Q[indexk&idxQND]^-0.22*Dr[indexk&idxQND]^-0.10*N[indexk&idxQND]^0.49)
	if (sum(indexk&idxQN)>0) 
		M[indexk&idxQN] <- pmin(100,6.59*size^1.63*Q[indexk&idxQN]^-0.24*N[indexk&idxQN]^0.63)
	if (sum(indexk&idxND)>0) 
		M[indexk&idxND] <- pmin(100,4.67*size^1.53*Dr[indexk&idxND]^-0.48*N[indexk&idxND]^0.6)
	# ---  Francis -----------------------------------------------
	if (sum(indexf)>0)
		M[indexf]  <-  
				100*sin((pi/180)*pmin(90,-17.98 + 45.62 *  H[indexf]^0.181 * Dr[indexf]^-0.207 * size^0.224))^2
	# --- Pelton --------------------------------------------------
	if (sum(indexp)>0)
		M[indexp] <- 100
	# --- ichtyocompatible ----------------------------------------
	if (sum(indexi)>0)
		M[indexi] <- 0	
	return(M)
}
eel_mortality_size(Dr=1.78,Q=8,N=117,H=3,QND="QND",size=0.70, typ="Francis") #21.49
eel_mortality_size(Dr=1.3,Q=5.2,N=205,H=3,QND="QND",size=0.70, typ="Kaplan") #70.35

#'  eel mortalities for a matrix of size class and abundance, Applies the eel_mortality_size to a matrix of size
#' 
#' This function takes the matrix of size class and the matrix of size number (these can vary from one turbine to the next)
#' and return either a vector of the average mortality (weighted by proportion of the different size) or
#' the matrix of mortality to get the detail of mortality per size
#' @param size_table A table containing the proportion of size per turbine (the sum of row must be one)
#' @param middle_class A table containing the "average" size to which the proportion applies, this
#' can be the center of the class or the average value of the class center derived from the population structure if available
#' @param return_type One of vector or matrix, if matrix the class will return a list with the mortality per size class
#' otherwise it will return,  Default: c("vector", "matrix")
#' @param ... Other parameters passed to the smolt_mortality_size function EXCEPT the size
#' @return Either a matrix with size in column and turbine in line or a vector of mortalities per turbine
#' @author Cédric Briand, Mathilde Labedan
#' #' @examples 
#' \dontrun{
#' if(interactive()){
#eel_mortality_allsize(
#		size_table=data.frame(
#				"s0.50"=rep(1/3,3),
#				"s0.70"=rep(1/3,3),
#				"s0.90"=rep(1/3,3))	, 
#		middle_class = c(0.5,0.7,0.9)	,
#		Dr = c(1.78,1.3,1.5,0,1.5), 
#		H = c(3,   3,   4.4,0,5.2),
#		N = c(117,205,122,0,223),
#		Q = c(8,5.2,5.5,0,12),
#		QND=c(NA,"QND",NA,NA,"QND"),
#		typ = c("Francis","Kaplan","Francis","Pelton","Kaplan"),
#		return_type="matrix")
#[,1]      [,2]      [,3]
#[1,]  16.94863  21.49516  25.39744
#[2,]  44.52102  70.35569  99.02292
#[3,]  23.47612  29.11836  33.86979
#[4,] 100.00000 100.00000 100.00000
#[5,]  38.05057  60.13057  84.63145
#'  }
#' }
#' @rdname eel_mortality_allsize
#' @export 		
eel_mortality_allsize <-function(size_table, middle_class,return_type="vector",...) {
	if (length(return_type)>1) stop("Return type choose one value, vector or matrix")
	if (!return_type %in% c("vector","matrix")) stop("return_type should be one of vector or matrix")
	if (ncol(size_table)!=length(middle_class)) stop("the number of column of size_table and the length of middle_class have to match")
	# apply the  mortality size to each size class center	
	mortality_table <- mapply(eel_mortality_size, size=middle_class, MoreArgs=list(...))
	if (return_type=="vector"){
		return(round(rowSums(mortality_table*size_table),2))
	} else {
		return(round(mortality_table,2))
	}
}


eel_mortality_allsize(
		size_table=data.frame(
				"s0.50"=rep(1/3,3),
				"s0.70"=rep(1/3,3),
				"s0.90"=rep(1/3,3))	, 
		middle_class = c(0.5,0.7,0.9)	,
		Dr = c(1.78,1.3,1.5,0,1.5), 
		H = c(3,   3,   4.4,0,5.2),
		N = c(117,205,122,0,223),
		Q = c(8,5.2,5.5,0,12),
		QND=c(NA,"QND",NA,NA,"QND"),
		typ = c("Francis","Kaplan","Francis","Pelton","Kaplan"),
		return_type="matrix")
```

# Processing data on turbines and keeping track.

In the main function on turbine calculation, we try to keep track of what we
have done. In many cases you don't have the information needed to run the best
model by which you can evaluate mortality. So sometimes you have to do some
assumptions or run a degraded model. Here we show how we keep track of that.
In the end we get the list of all the codes so for instance 2_4&3_4 will mean that the missing diameter has
been estimated by Gomez and Larinier (2008) and that the full formula with QND has been used.

# Basin scale test : the Adour

The method loads all data concerning hydropower plants. Then a selection of the
hpp within the basin is done by the  `segment_mortality` method.

segment mortality will reduce the dataset to the idsegment_sea selected
It will also use argument migrationflow to select only the Qi selected for
calculation (e.g remove Q97.5 and Q75 if those are not used for migration flow).

It will then calculate the mortality at all dams and use the matrix of dam
mortality to calcule the mortality during the downstream run from any single
riversegment of the basin. The mortality per segment multiplied by the
production of silver eel of each segment allows to calculate mortality at the
level of the basin. 

The morality calculated at each individual dam is more tricky to calculate as
several dam may belong to the same riversegment. I don't try to explain this
it's too complex and I've still made an error that I need to fix anyways.

Two methods are run below, the second uses a "default" mortality for all the dams where we don't have any information while the first only uses dams where turbine data are reported.

The methods displaying various maps at the basin level or at the level of a dam are tested.

```{r export_shiny, eval=FALSE, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Calculations for different options and store them in a list ----------------------


#turb_rios@tablemortalitydam$prop_preserve <- rep(0.1, nrow(turb_rios@tablemortalitydam))


# this is for the migration scenario
con=dbConnect(PostgreSQL(),
		dbname="eda2.3",
		host="localhost",
		port=5432,
		user= userlocal,
		password= passwordlocal)
other_silver <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT rn.idsegment, rn.seaidsegment, pi.name as basin, nsilver, nsilver_pmax_tr, nsilver_wd 
				FROM dbeel_rivers.rne
				JOIN dbeel_rivers.rn ON rn.idsegment=rne.idsegment
				JOIN  eda_gerem.pilot_basins pi ON pi.seaidsegment=rn.seaidsegment;")
dbDisconnect(con)
#WHERE seaidsegment in ('PT56183','SP224290','SP128132','FR118671','SP109916','SP118297','PT31034');")
save(other_silver, file=str_c(ddatawd, "othersilver.Rdata"))

load(file=str_c(ddatawd, "othersilver.Rdata"))
load( file=str_c(ddatawd,"turb_rios.Rdata"))
tmigration_flow <- readRDS("C:/workspace/EDAdata/report2.3/data/migration_flow_temp.Rds")

con=dbConnect(PostgreSQL(),
		dbname="eda2.3",
		host="localhost",
		port=5432,
		user= userlocal,
		password= passwordlocal)
basins <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM eda_gerem.pilot_basins")
current_nsilver <- turb_rios@data$nsilver # saved before
# this is all dams in sudoe 

# basin.<-'Adour'
# this will create a list of all combinations





gt2list <- list()
first_run <- TRUE
# Currently I've only done Adour
for (basin. in "Adour"){
	seaidsegment. <- subset(basins, name==basin.)$seaidsegment
	gt2list[[basin.]] <- list()
	cat("basin :",basin.,"\n")
	gt2list[[basin.]][["seaidsegment"]] <- seaidsegment.
	if (basin. == 'Adour') {
		turb_rios@tablemortalitydam$prop_preserve <- rep(0.1, nrow(turb_rios@tablemortalitydam))
	} else {
		turb_rios@tablemortalitydam$prop_preserve <- rep(0, nrow(turb_rios@tablemortalitydam))
	}
	query <- glue_sql( "SELECT idsegment, geom FROM dbeel_rivers.rn_rna where seaidsegment={seaidsegment.}", .con=con)
	bv_layer <-  read_sf(con, query=query)
	bv_layer <- st_transform(bv_layer,4326)
	#saveRDS(bv_layer, file= file.path("C:/workspace/Shiny_results/GT2_data",str_c(basin.,".rds")))
	gt2list[[basin.]][["bv_layer"]] <- bv_layer
	for (repartition. in c("Current", "Transport","Pristine")){
		cat("...repartition :",repartition.,"\n")
		gt2list[[basin.]][[repartition.]] <- list()
		if (repartition. == "Current"){
			# do nothing			 
		} else if (repartition. == "Transport"){
			# This will replace "nsilver" column by transport "nsilver_pmax_tr" estimates
			# TODO recalculate mortalities in turb_rios, according to size structure change
			new_silver <- other_silver %>% filter(basin==basin.) %>% pull(nsilver_pmax_tr)
			indexns = match(other_silver$idsegment, turb_rios@data$idsegment)
			if (any(is.na(indexns))) stop("Missing values in new_silver")
			turb_rios@data$nsilver[indexns] <- new_silver			
		} else if (repartition. == "Pristine"){
			# This will replace "nsilver" column by pristine "nsilver_wd" estimates
			new_nilver <- other_silver %>% filter(basin==basin.) %>% pull(nsilver_wd)
			indexns = match(other_silver$idsegment, turb_rios@data$idsegment)
			if (any(is.na(indexns))) stop("Missing values in new_silver")
			turb_rios@data$nsilver[indexns] <- new_silver			
		} else {
			warning("Undefined value ")
		}
				
		for (migration. in c("Vilaine","Elorn","Touques")){	
			cat("......migration :",migration.,"\n")
			gt2list[[basin.]][[repartition.]][[migration.]] <- list()
			for (model_missing. in c(FALSE, TRUE)){
		    cat("......model missing :",model_missing.,"\n")
				# this will test missing values for basins, using default...
				# TODO check how to collect default values for all basins
				gt2list[[basin.]][[repartition.]][[migration.]][[as.character(model_missing.)]] <- list()
				if (model_missing.==FALSE){
					default_mortality.=NULL
				} else {
					default_mortality. <- c(
							mortality_q_1004_10 = 0.12, 
							mortality_q_1004_20 = 0.13, 
							mortality_q_1004_30 = 0.13, 
							mortality_q_1004_40 = 0.13, 
							mortality_q_1004_50 = 0.12,
							mortality_q_1004_60 = 0.11,
							mortality_q_1004_70 = 0.10,
							mortality_q_1004_80 = 0.08,
							mortality_q_1004_90 = 0.06,
							mortality_q_1004_95 = 0.05,
							mortality_q_1004_99 = 0.04)
				}
				# Main calculation !!!
				turb_adour <- segment_mortality(
						object =turb_rios, 
						seaidsegment = seaidsegment.,
						migrationflow=tmigration_flow[tmigration_flow$loc==migration.,],
						default_mortality = default_mortality.)	
				load(file=str_c(ddatawd,"/list_sauv",seaidsegment,".Rdata")) # list_sauv
				# this dataset is created by segment_mortality
				if (first_run){
					first_run <- FALSE
					# here I add constant parts
					gt2list[["datadam"]] <- turb_adour@datadam
					gt2list[["tableflow"]] <- turb_adour@tableflow
					gt2list[["tableturbinedbeel"]] <- turb_adour@tableturbinedbeel
					gt2list[["tablehppdbeel"]] <- turb_adour@tablehppdbeel	
					query <- glue_sql ("SELECT op_id, the_geom FROM sudoang.view_dbeel_hpp ", .con= con)
					hpp_layer <- read_sf(con, query=query)
					hpp_layer <- st_transform(hpp_layer, 4326)
					gt2list[["hpp_layer"]] <- hpp_layer
					# TODO add datadam tableflow tableturbinedbeel tablehppdbeel default_mortality.
				} # end loop model_missing.
				# Here I add changing parts
				gt2list[[basin.]][[repartition.]][[migration.]][[as.character(model_missing.)]][["tablemortalityturbine"]] <-
						turb_adour@tablemortalityturbine	
				gt2list[[basin.]][[repartition.]][[migration.]][[as.character(model_missing.)]][["tablemortalitydam"]] <-
						turb_adour@tablemortalitydam
				gt2list[[basin.]][[repartition.]][[migration.]][[as.character(model_missing.)]][["default_mortality"]] <-
						default_mortality.
				gt2list[[basin.]][[repartition.]][[migration.]][[as.character(model_missing.)]][["data"]] <-
						turb_adour@data
				gt2list[[basin.]][[repartition.]][[migration.]][[as.character(model_missing.)]][["main_results"]] <-
						list_sauv
			} # end loop migration ---------
			
		} # end for model missing loop ---------
		
		turb_rios@data$nsilver <- 	current_nsilver
		
		
	} # end for repartition. loop ----------------
	
} # end for basin. loop ----------------
save(gt2list, file = str_c(ddatawd, "gt2list.Rdata"))
```
